claims.text: Many customers love the drill and find it quiet, efficient, and easy to use.
Several reviewers report the unit arrived broken or stopped working after little use, including motor failures and burning smells.
Customers appreciate the included extra bits and sanders that come with the product.
Some buyers had issues with the bit holder or changing bits, and found the instructions hard to understand.
A few customers mention the seller responded quickly and replaced faulty units.
